about.title: About PBO Vidar
body: PBO Vidar is a Ukrainian-Norwegian maritime technology company focused on unmanned surface platforms, rapid system integration and mission-driven engineering.
We combine Scandinavian platform expertise with Ukrainian development, testing and operational insight.
